scenario: Clear consultation with all checklist items covered

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: What is the main problem that brought you in today?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: I have a sharp pain in the lower right side of my abdomen.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: When did this pain start?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: It started yesterday evening at around 7 PM.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: So it has been there since yesterday evening. Has it been continuous since then?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: Yes, it has been there continuously for about 18 hours.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: Can you point to exactly where the pain is?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: It is mostly in the lower right abdomen.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: On a scale from zero to ten, how severe is the pain right now?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: About seven out of ten.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: Do you have any other symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, fever, or diarrhea?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: I feel nauseous and I had a mild fever last night, but no vomiting or diarrhea.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: Are you currently taking any medications?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: Yes, I take metformin 500 milligrams twice a day.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: Do you have any known allergies, especially medication allergies?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: Yes, I am allergic to penicillin. I get a rash.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: Do you have any previous medical conditions or major illnesses?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: I have type 2 diabetes, diagnosed three years ago. No other major conditions.

transcript_turns.speaker: doctor
transcript_turns.text: Does anyone in your close family have diabetes, heart disease, or other significant medical conditions?

transcript_turns.speaker: patient
transcript_turns.text: My father also has type 2 diabetes. My mother has high blood pressure.
